title: Super admin
subtitle: Platform, every feature and the integrations each one uses
source: Muleshoe Chamber of Commerce & Agriculture (Base44): Layout.jsx, roles.js, backend functions, SmtpSetting, AiConciergeSetting, IntegrationSetting, app secrets

root.label: Super admin
root.desc: Everything in a chamber app plus the platform, outside services and integrations. Integrations used are listed on each feature.

children.label: Integrations
children.desc: Every outside service, what it is for, where it is set up, its keys, and what uses it. This is the checklist to follow when setting up a new chamber.

children.label: Emailit
children.desc: Main outbound email: one-off emails, campaigns, newsletters, invites, approvals, invoices, form notices.
children.setup: Verify the chamber sending domain in Emailit, add the API key and webhook secret, set the from address, then send a test.

children.label: SMTP (fallback)
children.desc: Optional SMTP sending, e.g. Hostinger mail. Base44 built-in email is the last fallback.
keys: SMTP host, user and password (stored in SmtpSetting)
usedBy: All email, only when the provider is set to SMTP
children.setup: Only if not using Emailit.

children.label: Amazon SES
children.desc: Not wired into the chamber apps today. Only an HQ docs folder mentions it.
children.setup: Nothing to do unless we switch email providers.

children.label: Cloudflare Email Routing
children.desc: Inbound email: mail to the chamber address goes through a Cloudflare Email Worker into the Inbox.
children.where: Cloudflare dashboard (Email Routing + Worker) and Platform → Integrations → Inbound Email
children.setup: Add the chamber domain's routing rule to the worker, set the bridge secret in both places, check Inbound Email status.

children.label: OpenAI
children.desc: AI Concierge, website builder AI, member website AI, Spanish drafts, Site Text translation, Business Coach.
children.where: Platform → Integrations → AI Concierge (key and model); Website AI tab for builder models
children.setup: Add the key, pick the models, then ask the Concierge a test question.

children.label: Base44 AI (InvokeLLM)
children.desc: Base44's built-in AI, billed to Base44 credits. No key needed.
children.setup: Nothing to set up. Watch Base44 credits.

children.label: Base44 AI (ExtractData)
children.desc: Reads uploaded files: knowledge base documents and member imports.
children.setup: Nothing to set up.

children.label: alttext.ai
children.desc: Writes alt text for uploaded images.
children.setup: Add the key.

children.label: Cloudflare R2
children.desc: Image and media storage.
children.setup: Use a folder or bucket per chamber and set the public URL.

children.label: Cloudflare for SaaS
children.desc: Custom domains for member websites.
children.where: Cloudflare dashboard; managed by the manageCustomHostname function
children.setup: Only if the chamber sells member websites.

children.label: Cloudflare edge worker
children.desc: Serves member sites and records visits and form posts at the edge.
children.where: Cloudflare Workers; functions recordEdgeAttributionEvent, submitEdgeForm, resolveEdgeWebsite
children.setup: Point the worker at the new app.

children.label: WordPress
children.desc: Posts news and member listings to a WordPress site.
keys: WordPress site URL, user and application password
children.setup: Only if the chamber keeps a WordPress site.

children.label: TinyCommand webhook
children.desc: Facebook Auto-Post: sends new news, events, deals and jobs to Facebook.
children.setup: Build the TinyCommand flow for the chamber's Facebook page and paste its webhook URL.

children.label: GoBrunch
children.desc: Virtual event rooms and registration.
children.setup: Only if the chamber runs virtual events.

children.label: Twilio / Easify SMS
children.desc: Text alerts and event reminders. Not set up for Muleshoe.
children.setup: Pick a provider, add credentials and sender number, turn on Text Alerts.

children.label: PWA push
children.desc: Push notifications to the installed app, sent through the Hostinger PWA and Gravitec.
children.setup: Set both secrets after the PWA is created in HQ.

children.label: Google / ICS feeds
children.desc: Calendar feeds members can subscribe to.
children.setup: Nothing to set up.

children.label: Stripe
children.desc: Payments, invoices, dues and sponsor ad checkout. Finance is off for Muleshoe.
children.setup: Connect the chamber's own Stripe account, then turn Money on in Chamber Features.

children.label: Scheduled Jobs
children.desc: Hourly runner for anything timed.
children.setup: See Outside the app → Scheduled Jobs.

children.label: Platform
children.desc: Super admin only. Platform settings inside each chamber app (Muleshoe sidebar → Platform).

children.desc: This dashboard. Reads each chamber app every 4 hours through its hqConnector function.
keys: HQ_CONNECTOR_KEY (in each chamber app and in HQ)
children.setup: Add the chamber in HQ → Chambers → Add and paste its HQ connector key.

children.label: PWA (installable app)

children.label: Scheduled Jobs

children.setup: Check the workflow exists and runs hourly, 6 AM to 10 PM Central.

children.label: Base44 app secrets
children.desc: All API keys live in the Base44 app's environment secrets, not in the code.
children.setup: Duplicated apps do not reliably carry secrets. Re-enter every key from the Integrations branch.
